pages.title: Why Connect
pages.text: The mod is fully playable without an AI: Herobrine falls back to preset lines. Once connected, his replies are generated live by a large language model and match the moment much better.$(br2)Entry point: open the Conversation Manager → "LLM Settings" → API setup. Keys and other settings are stored only on your own computer, never in the world save.

pages.title: Cloud Setup in 3 Steps
pages.text: $(li)Pick a provider: presets for DeepSeek official, OpenRouter, Qiniu (OpenAI-compatible and Claude endpoints) and Gemini are built in, plus a Custom mode.$(li)Enter the API key: register on the provider's site, create a key, and paste the whole string in.$(li)Fetch models: with the endpoint and key filled in, click "Fetch model list", pick a model from the dropdown and save.

pages.title: Custom Endpoints
pages.text: Custom mode sends OpenAI-compatible requests: fill in the full chat endpoint URL (usually ending in /v1/chat/completions), the model ID and a display name.$(br2)The Gemini preset uses Google's native API instead — the URL is pre-filled, you only need a key and a model.

pages.title: Local Models
pages.text: Want your own computer to generate Herobrine's replies? Prepare a model and start a local app outside Minecraft, then enter its connection settings in the game.$(br2)The mod will not download, install or start anything.$(br2)Follow $(l:herobrine_companion:llm_connection/local_model_setup)Local Model Setup$(/l) for plain-language instructions, URL examples and troubleshooting.

pages.title: About Proxies
pages.text: If your provider needs a proxy, enable "Follow system proxy" in LLM Settings: cloud chats, model discovery and context probing use the system proxy. Local services always connect directly.$(br2)If the proxy app is not running while this switch is on, cloud requests may time out. Turn the switch off to restore direct access.

pages.title: Verifying the Connection
pages.text: After saving, just say something to him. For call-by-call details open "LLM Settings" → "AI Debug", which shows each request's status code and raw response.$(br2)If it doesn't work, see the $(l:herobrine_companion:llm_connection/llm_error_codes)Error Quick Reference$(/l).
